name: smwmusic-mega-man-iv-wily-s-disco-station-dr-wily-s-station-remix
title: Mega Man IV - Wily's Disco Station ~ Dr. Wily's Station (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of the insanely underrated and hype-as-fricc Wily's Station from Mega Man IV GB (commonly dubbed as "Mega Man World IV"). This game's soundtrack may consist of a lotta ports of the NES themes from Mega Man 4 & 5, but goddamn!! the original songs are some of the best in the series.

Wily's Station... Oh my god!! It's one of the most unique fortress themes, and it's become one of my favorites given the funky & upbeat energy this song shoves into your face. It's super catchy and definitely one that's been on my mind for months ever since I played through Mega Man World IV (and beat it) a few months back.

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also two versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables the voice clips (Listening-Only, not SMW Compatible)
2. Disables the voice clips (SMW-Compatible, turned on default)
